cond_0017.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the development and maintenance of a qualified supplier pipeline, determine supplier effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement through data analysis and quality control processes.
cond_0017.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Lead regular communication with Suppliers to address concerns and drive an environment of continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Own tracking of Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and execute the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Direct support to warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Lead development of Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Proactively identify trending issues internally and drive corrective actions to resolution.
Take ownership of resolving external nonconformances and issues.
Participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Ensure achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0017.requirements:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly autonomous and self-assigning.
Can work and maintain communication with multiple teams simultaneously.
Can tactfully follow up on action items of others.
Can elicit feedback from others in a positive way.
Excellent auditing practices.
Advanced presentation skills using Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages.
Expert in multiple root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Intermediate with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Intermediate in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Excellent in Quality data analytics and interpretation.

Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.

Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program.

The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of supplier data and quality control processes.
cond_0049.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0049.requirements:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly autonomous and self-assigning.
Can work and maintain communication with multiple teams simultaneously.
Can tactfully follow up on action items of others.
Can elicit feedback from others in a positive way.
Excellent auditing practices.
Advanced presentation skills using Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages.
Expert in multiple root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Intermediate with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Intermediate in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Excellent in Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Intermediate in Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program.
ASQ certification in Quality Engineering (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Root Cause Analysis (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Internal Auditing (Or approved equivalent).
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Welding and fabrication techniques.
Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program.
Certified ASQ Quality Auditor is a plus.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Knowledge of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Position is at least 25% to 50% at a desk working with a computer with balance of time performing audits off-site. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to outside environmental conditions.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with supplier auditing and quality control work.
cond_0158.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0158.requirements:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly autonomous and self-assigning.
Can work and maintain communication with multiple teams simultaneously.
Can tactfully follow up on action items of others.
Can elicit feedback from others in a positive way.
Excellent auditing practices.
Advanced presentation skills using Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages.
Expert in multiple root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Intermediate with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Intermediate in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Excellent in Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Intermediate in Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program.
ASQ certification in Quality Engineering (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Root Cause Analysis (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Internal Auditing (Or approved equivalent).
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Welding and fabrication techniques.
Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program.
Certified ASQ Quality Auditor is a plus.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Knowledge of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Position is at least 25% to 50% at a desk working with a computer with balance of time performing audits off-site. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. cond_0220.intro: The Supplier Quality Engineer works to provide the organization with an adequate pipeline of qualified suppliers and manufacturers. The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp supplier data and quality control processes.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].

cond_0228.intro: The Supplier Quality Engineer works to provide the organization with an adequate pipeline of qualified suppliers and manufacturers. The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes.
cond_0228.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0228.requirements:
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Some background in Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Familiarity with Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Exposure to Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Background in Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Working knowledge of Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Familiarity with Welding and fabrication techniques.
Working knowledge of Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program, or equivalent practical experience.
ASQ Quality Auditor certification is a plus, or willingness to obtain.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Awareness of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Comfortable working independently and managing your own workload.
Able to work and maintain communication with multiple teams at the same time.
Willingness to follow up on action items and elicit feedback from others constructively.
Working knowledge of auditing practices.
Comfort with Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages for presentations.
Experience with root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Familiarity with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Background in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Experience with Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Familiarity with Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program, or equivalent practical experience.

The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of supplier data and quality control processes.
cond_0319.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0319.requirements:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly autonomous and self-assigning.
Can work and maintain communication with multiple teams simultaneously.
Can tactfully follow up on action items of others.
Can elicit feedback from others in a positive way.
Excellent auditing practices.
Advanced presentation skills using Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages.
Expert in multiple root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Intermediate with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Intermediate in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Excellent in Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Intermediate in Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program.
ASQ certification in Quality Engineering (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Root Cause Analysis (Or approved equivalent).
ASQ certification in Internal Auditing (Or approved equivalent).
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Welding and fabrication techniques.
Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program.
Certified ASQ Quality Auditor is a plus.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Knowledge of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Position is at least 25% to 50% at a desk working with a computer with balance of time performing audits off-site. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to outside environmental conditions.

cond_0336.intro: The Supplier Quality Engineer works to provide the organization with an adequate pipeline of qualified suppliers and manufacturers. The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes.
cond_0336.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0336.requirements:
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Some background in Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Familiarity with Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Exposure to Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Background in Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Working knowledge of Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Familiarity with Welding and fabrication techniques.
Working knowledge of Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program, or equivalent practical experience.
ASQ Quality Auditor certification is a plus, or willingness to obtain.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Awareness of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Comfortable working independently and managing your own workload.
Able to work and maintain communication with multiple teams at the same time.
Willingness to follow up on action items and elicit feedback from others constructively.
Working knowledge of auditing practices.
Comfort with Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages for presentations.
Experience with root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Familiarity with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Background in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Experience with Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Familiarity with Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program, or equivalent practical experience.

The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with supplier auditing, corrective action processes, and quality data analysis.
cond_0473.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.

cond_0516.intro: The Supplier Quality Engineer works to provide the organization with an adequate pipeline of qualified suppliers and manufacturers. The Supplier Quality Engineer works to help determine the effectiveness in which a Supplier can provide its services to the organization and assists in further improving the Suppliers abilities and level of service through the analysis of data and the application quality control processes.
cond_0516.responsibilities:
Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].
cond_0516.requirements:
Flexible schedule and ability to travel for extended periods of time if needed.
Some background in Quality Auditing with focus on Supply Chain.
Familiarity with Nonconformance and Corrective Action investigations.
Exposure to Supplier Performance Monitoring Tools.
Background in Supplier Development and Improvement Practices.
Working knowledge of Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Familiarity with Welding and fabrication techniques.
Working knowledge of Mechanical & Electrical installation practices.
Bachelor's degree in quality engineering from an accredited four-year program, or equivalent practical experience.
ASQ Quality Auditor certification is a plus, or willingness to obtain.
Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt is a plus.
Awareness of new technologies and their application (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, etc.).
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Comfortable working independently and managing your own workload.
Able to work and maintain communication with multiple teams at the same time.
Willingness to follow up on action items and elicit feedback from others constructively.
Working knowledge of auditing practices.
Comfort with Microsoft Office Suite and other software packages for presentations.
Experience with root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.).
Familiarity with common industrial manufacturing processes (raw material processing, welding, coating, assembly, etc.).
Background in Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods.
Experience with Quality data analytics and interpretation.
Familiarity with Engineering design principles and design philosophies.
Basic understanding of metrology and measuring devices and principles.
Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch).

Conduct initial and periodic supplier quality audits to ensure suppliers remain in compliance with company's standards.
Communicate with Suppliers regularly to address any concerns and foster an environment that facilitates continual improvement.
Maintain supplier performance evaluation documentation records.
Assist in tracking Supplier Performance indicators in collaboration with Procurement teams.
Analyze data, create SCARS as needed and follow the 8D process to ensure responses are delivered and accepted in a timely manner.
Assist with the warehouse and material receiving inspectors, including communications with Suppliers when there are packaging and receiving issues when materials arrive.
Assist in developing Inspection Test Plans (with focus on subcontracted service scopes).
Develop and implement appropriate data collection methods for the Quality department and others as needed.
Participate in DFMEA / PFMEA discussions.
Analyze and communicate organizational performance and non-conformance data respective to Supplier activities.
Work internally to highlight trending issues and open corrective actions to resolve.
Assist in working through external nonconformances and issues.
Will participate in individual education and development programs.
Stay abreast of all standards, codes, and regulations relevant to [Company name masked].
Support achievement of quality department objectives.
Any other work assigned by [Company name masked].

Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited four-year program
ASQ certification in Quality Engineering (or approved equivalent)

Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly autonomous and self-assigning
Can work and maintain communication with multiple teams simultaneously
Can tactfully follow up on action items of others
Can elicit feedback from others in a positive way
Excellent auditing practices

Expert in multiple root cause and corrective action investigation techniques (5 Why, Fishbone, Change/Event analysis, etc.)

Intermediate in Engineering design principles and design philosophies

Basic understanding of metallurgical principles (MTRs, basic ASTM interpretation of materials, testing to include tensile, Charpy and micro-etch)
